verdict.rationale: Semgrep AppSec Platform exposes a documented API, so scoped credentials are a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence describes issuing API tokens with limited scopes, least-privilege permissions, or agent-specific credentials. Semgrep Secrets detects leaked credentials, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
